subject: Marketplace renewal — regional split & invoice orchestration
messages:
From: procurement@greencloud.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2028-06-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: Renewal and Private Offer — regional split and invoices

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. GreenCloud is preparing to renew our Redwood subscription and we'd like to move to a private offer in AWS with a regional split: 60% US, 40% EU for the upcoming 12‑month term. Procurement has a few constraints we need to document up front so accounting can schedule invoices across tranches (Q1/Q3) and manage VAT for the EU portion.

Can Redwood provide a recommended invoice schedule and a consolidated PO template that maps SKUs to regional buckets? Also please confirm the preferred acceptance criteria for the marketplace private offer so we can align our internal procurement/finance teams.

Attached is our initial procurement form (we'll send the draft PO next). Happy to jump on a short call next week.

Best,
Procurement Team
GreenCloud Inc
[Attachment: GC_procurement_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: procurement@greencloud.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-16T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal and Private Offer — regional split and invoices

Hi team,

Thanks — looping in Marissa (Marketplace Ops) and Rafael (Billing) to make this concrete. We've put together a short execution runbook that covers:

- Marketplace private offer acceptance windows and expected lead times
- How to map purchase order lines to regional billing buckets (US/EU)
- Recommended invoice tranches and suggested dates tied to your fiscal quarters
- EU VAT handling and what information we need from your tax team
- DocuSign flow for the consolidated PO + acceptance confirmation

See attached: Renewal-Execution-Runbook.xlsx — it's a working doc, please review and flag anything we missed. High‑level proposal: two invoices (40% EU invoice net of VAT handling, 60% US invoice) issued on acceptance and 6 months later. If you'd prefer three tranches we can re-sketch.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review the runbook and confirm preferred invoice cadence (procurement) — due 2028-06-23
2) Redwood to produce marketplace private offer and draft DocuSign PO — due 2028-06-30
3) Acceptance window planning & QA (Marketplace Ops) — target 2 week window after PO sign

Marissa / Rafael — can you confirm the technical mapping for SKU->region and whether we need separate offers per registry scope?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Renewal-Execution-Runbook.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

From: samantha.lee@greencloud.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: ap+billing@greencloud.com
Date: 2028-06-20T10:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal and Private Offer — regional split and invoices

Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Procurement/Finance:

- GreenCloud prefers a consolidated PO (single DocuSign envelope) that itemizes regional quantities and the invoice schedule.
- We will require Redwood to include VAT breakdown on the EU invoice; our tax team will supply a VAT registration number by 2028-06-25.
- Preferred cadence: Acceptance invoice (50% of EU bucket invoiced on sign), remainder 50% of EU bucket at month 6; US bucket invoiced 50% at sign and 50% at month 9.

I've uploaded our draft PO for Redwood to review and included a DocuSign link when you're ready: https://docusign.com/link/abc123-greencloud-po

Forwarding our draft now for your legal/billing review.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Lead, GreenCloud
[Attachment: GreenCloud_PO_Draft.docx (Word)]

From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Cc: procurement@greencloud.com
Date: 2028-07-12T08:35:00Z

On Tue, Jun 20, 2028 at 10:21 AM samantha.lee@greencloud.com wrote:
> Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Procurement/Finance:
> ...

Adding Marketplace Ops notes — tagging internal runbook sections below for clarity and action owners:

- Offer topology: We can publish a single AWS private offer scoped to multiple regional listings (US + EU). Ops needs SKU mapping from Billing to ensure meter reconciliation. (Owner: Marissa)
- Acceptance window: Recommend 10 business day acceptance period after DocuSign completes to allow market registration and bookkeeping. (Owner: Marketplace Ops)
- Billing: Rafael — will the billing system emit two invoices (one for EU VAT accounting, one for US) for the single PO? If not, we need to emit separate PDF invoices post-acceptance and push to GreenCloud AP.
- Docs: I've added a sample mapping to JIRA (MKT-1287) and a draft Acceptance Checklist in Drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1r3RenewalRunbook

Also flagging a potential delay: if GreenCloud needs a VAT credit note flow, Finance will require an additional step (VAT validation) before final invoice issuance — this may shift the second tranche by ~2 weeks.

Soojin Lee
Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference

Team — quick internal summary and next steps so we can close this by end of August: 

Summary:
- Account: GreenCloud Inc (deal GC-2028-1182) — renewal via AWS private offer scoped US/EU
- Commercial split: US 60% / EU 40% (GreenCloud proposed slight variant; procurement requested mixed cadence; final cadence to be reconciled)
- Attachments we currently hold: Renewal-Execution-Runbook.xlsx, GreenCloud_PO_Draft.docx, PO_8982.pdf (procurement form)

Immediate actions (owners & deadlines):
1) Billing (Rafael) — produce final invoice PDF templates for double-invoice workflow (EU VAT breakdown + US invoice) and confirm how they will be pushed to GreenCloud AP. Due 2028-08-25.
2) Marketplace Ops (Marissa) — confirm whether a single private offer can be active for both region scopes in AWS or whether we need two offers for reconciliation. Also confirm acceptance window dates. Due 2028-08-24.
3) Soojin — draft a short acceptance checklist (from the Drive doc) we can attach to the DocuSign envelope. Due 2028-08-23.
4) I will prepare the DocuSign envelope with the consolidated PO lines and link it to the private offer once we have Rafael's invoice PDFs. Target to send DocuSign: 2028-08-28.

Procurement (GreenCloud) — Samantha, if those dates work on your end we'll proceed to finalize DocuSign and the private offer. Please confirm VAT number by 2028-08-22.

I'll keep threads concise from here on; feel free to reply with questions.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
